## 4. Float64 Audit — Discrepancies Between float64 and 120-Digit

**All k values (integer lattice coordinates) agree between float64 and 120-digit.**

This is expected: for most particle mass ratios, the continuous lattice coordinate
N×log₂(r) falls far enough from a half-integer that 15-digit precision suffices
to determine the nearest integer. The ε values, however, DIFFER significantly —
float64 gives only ~15 correct digits of ε, while the 120-digit computation gives 120.
